name: Manasseh
summary: Joseph's firstborn son, born in Egypt. Jacob claimed him as his own son, but when blessing him put his younger brother Ephraim first.

key_moments.title: Named Manasseh by Joseph
key_moments.description: Joseph's wife Asenath bore him two sons before the famine. He named the firstborn Manasseh, because God had made him forget his hardship and his father's house.

key_moments.title: Claimed by Jacob
key_moments.description: When Jacob was sick, Joseph brought his two sons to him. Jacob said Ephraim and Manasseh would be his own, just like Reuben and Simeon.

key_moments.title: Blessed Second, After Ephraim
key_moments.description: Jacob laid his right hand on Ephraim and his left on Manasseh, even though Manasseh was the firstborn. Joseph tried to move his father's hand, but Jacob said the younger would be greater.
